rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for losing a memory, forgetting to do something, leaving something behind, or deciding to stop remembering it.

example.english: Don't forget to bring an umbrella.
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

rows.note: Use this when someone fails to notice or realize a fact rather than simply losing a memory.

example.english: I forget to notice that the light is still on.
example.traditional: 我成日唔為意盞燈仲着緊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 jat6 m4 wai4 ji3 zaan2 dang1 zung6 zoek3 gan2
